items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How did the -- did the musicians talk much about the war, about like Mussolini and Hitler and the Japanese and stuff like that?

ctx.x: '41 and '45. Well, like, if I remember, I spent a lot of time on 52nd Street and somehow, well, 52nd Street was the most prominent thing in my memory. The activity in music was terrific, you know. 52nd Street was really jumping; and, of course, when I traveled with my own group and with Art Tatum during those war years, it seemed like the whole country was eager to hear more jazz and more music, you know? Things were really popping.
